exit_variants.note: Same trades, same fills, four pre-declared exits; costs included. A construction change reaches PAPER only through a champion/challenger gate.

feature_confirmation.inference: tie-corrected Spearman IC per day; overlap-robust error for 10-session windows (research.overlap_inference); Student t (df=blocks-1); BH across features; >= 20 independent blocks and non-zero dispersion required
feature_confirmation.note: Pre-registered 2026-11-19. CONFIRMED is required before a challenger may use a feature; even then it reaches PAPER only through the champion/challenger gate.

provenance.method: production run_backtest + core.evaluation_spec; nominal overlap-robust 95% intervals per signal (research.overlap_inference); no multiplicity correction; in-sample diagnosis only
